name: Pacific Dunes

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth): here the OLC South Coast project, which DOGAMI labels 2009 and the USGS data reports date to flights in June-October 2008; exportImage (f=json) at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 385950-388150 / y 4782850-4787050 shared by Pacific Dunes, Old Macdonald and Sheep Ranch, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-21 (GitHub release pacific-dunes-data, _ags_5895eba5_2261_4029_9a2a_cf5121494bfb.tif).

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (OLC South Coast, flown 2008), exportImage (f=json) at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same shared box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-21 (GitHub release pacific-dunes-data, _ags_3c331496_959e_469c_8d52_987562653ff9.tif)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM), two exportImage JPEG tiles at 0.5 m shared by the three courses (south: x 386100-387980, y 4782960-4784960, release asset exportImage.jpg; north: y 4784960-4786960, sent by the developer in the chat 2026-10-21, upload of the original JPEG pending), stacked, georeferenced from the request boxes and cut to the world + 100 m by make_ortho.py

world.note: provisional: box of the 18 hole lines and their tees, greens, fairways and bunkers (x 386478-387285, y 4783211-4784764 (807 x 1,552 m)) plus at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred

scorecard_source: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort club scorecard, 2020 (file name) (Pacific-Dunes-Scorecard_2020-scaled.jpg, GitHub release pacific-dunes-data, sha256 48f99d27ce871559194fe0e1ed9ef7cdd733b481cbeb6d168acb310514c55f5b, read 2026-10-21). Every row adds up to its printed Out/In/Total; men's stroke index 1-18 complete; yardages, pars and stroke index agree with the GolfPass listing. Ratings/slopes are the card's men's figures (women's: Green 76.1/145, Gold 74.6/142, Royal Blue 63.9/115, Orange 70.3/131). The Orange row has its own stroke index (9,13,1,3,17,11,7,5,15 / 14,18,6,4,16,8,10,12,2), not stored. Local rules on the card: no-play zones on holes 4, 11 and 13 (penalty areas); sand other than raked bunkers is general area; Model Local Rule E-5. The card has no Blue; Green is the set closest to 6,300 yd (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1).
attribution: Elevation and canopy: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (gorse and tree checks)
Scorecard: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort (club scorecard)
notes: Intake 2026-10-21 (built with Pacific Dunes, Old Macdonald and Sheep Ranch together; shared rasters). Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): Green tees, all water red, OB = the OSM course polygon, trees from lidar; wind 8-16 mph as the developer set for Bandon Dunes; theme bandon_dunes with gorse from the 2024 photo, as at Bandon Dunes.
tree_type_note: the trees on the bluffs at Bandon are shore pine (and Sitka spruce in the hollows), whose broad wind-flattened crowns the crown-shape rule calls deciduous; the broadleaf scrub is drawn as gorse (as at Bandon Dunes)

gorse.note: as at Bandon Dunes (developer 2026-10-20): thickets from the OSIP 2024 orthophoto (pipeline/gorse.py); the ground under them is the gorse surface (17)

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar here was flown in 2008, older than parts of the course; lidar trees whose crowns are not dark canopy in the OSIP 2024 photo are dropped
